headline: Pakistan Central Bank Foreign Reserves Rise to $21.59 Billion
summary: Foreign exchange reserves held by the State Bank of Pakistan increased by $8 million to $21.59 billion during the week ending November 20.
why: Central bank foreign exchange reserves are a critical metric of a country's external stability and capacity to service external debt.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: An increase in central bank reserves enhances macroeconomic stability and external debt cover.
